summary: The state is sealed to 1 reader. Attributes, outputs and stored plans are encrypted. Addresses, types, names, dependencies and revisions stay readable, so the graph and the plans keep working.

file.text: The readers file matches the store.

recovery.text: Recovery: any 2 of 3 shares rebuild the recovery key (x25519:7rDj4D…). If every reader loses their key, the holders of 2 shares can open the state.

suggestions.title: Add a reader
suggestions.why: The new reader makes an identity and sends the line it prints. A current reader adds the line, commits it and rewraps.
suggestions.who: the new reader, then a current reader
